rows.title: Long Product Sync (2.5 mins)
rows.hypothesis: Haan to basically kal ka jo project sync tha usmein humne thoda sa discuss kiya ki app ka current status kya hai aur next week tak humein exactly kya complete karna hai. Abhi back end ka major part almost done hai. But transcription pipeline mein thoda latency issue aa raha hai. Kabhi kabhi audio upload karne ke baad transcript aane mein 30-40 seconds lag rahe hain. which is okay for a prototype but production mein itna delay nahi hona chahiye Rohit ne bola ki wo aaj evening tak check karega ki processing ko background job mein shift kar sakte hain ya nahi agar wo possible hai to user ko ek loading state dikha denge instead of making them wait on the same screen maine bola ki haan ye better approach hai Front End Site pe Neha ko Summary aur Action Items ka UI Finalize karna hai abhi Cards thode Basic hain to Ideally Summary ek Separate Section mein ho aur Action Items Checkbox ke saath dikhein Important ye hai ki agar Action Item mein Deadline ya kisi pasand ka naam Mention ho to wo bhi Extract ho jaye For example Friday client email output owner amit task client email due date Friday ek aur cheez. Humein English ke liye tasting aur karni padegi because kuch recordings mein English aur Hindi. Sentence ke beech mein switching kaafi frequent hai. Maine do sample recordings already share kar di hain. But Priya ko aur at least 5 recordings collect karke deni hai preferably different accents or different speaking speeds ke saath marketing wala part abhi hold pe rakho because product flow stable hone ke baad high landing page copy finalize karna useful hoga so immediate priority back-end latency action item extraction aur front-end UI hai aaj ke end tak Rohit latency ka update dega Neha latest UI screenshot share karegi aur Priya testing ke liye additional recordings upload karegi Main meanwhile extraction prompt ko improve karunga aur specifically dates, names aur tasks ko structured format mein nikalne ki koshish karunga. Aur haan kal subah 11 baje ek short 15 minute sync rakh lete hain usmein bas blockers discuss karenge koi long meeting nahi agar sab green hai to directly implementation continue karenge
rows.summary: The team discussed the current app status, focusing on resolving backend transcription latency and finalizing the frontend UI for summary and action items. Immediate priorities include backend latency optimization, action item extraction improvements, and collecting more Hinglish recordings for testing.

action_items.task: Check if processing can be shifted to a background job to resolve latency issues.
Finalize the UI for Summary and Action Items, making Summary a separate section and Action Items with checkboxes.
Collect and provide at least 5 more recordings with different accents and speaking speeds for Hinglish testing.
Provide an update on the backend latency issue.
Share the latest UI screenshots.
Upload additional recordings for testing.
Improve the extraction prompt to better capture structured dates, names, and tasks.
Attend a short 15-minute sync meeting to discuss blockers.
